newsitem.title: USA: U.S. December milk production off from yr ago - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. December milk production off from yr ago - USDA.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said milk production in the 22 major states during December was 11.1 billion pounds, down slightly from a year ago but up from a revised 10.7 billion pounds in November.
During 1996, milk production was 1.2 billion pounds less than 1995. On a daily basis, 1996 production averaged 4.4 million pounds per day less than 1995, the department said.
In the monthly report, USDA said production per cow in the 22 major states averaged 1,394 pounds for December, 14 pounds above December 1995.

The number of cows on farms in the 22 major states declined for the seventeenth month in a row to 7.94 million head, 97,000 head less than the same period a year ago and 6,000 head less than November.
The number of cows on farms averaged 101,000 less in 1996 and the number of milk cows on farms was the lowest on record, USDA said.
The department said it will change the states it surveys beginning with the January 1997 report. USDA said it plans to drop Maryland, North Carolina, and Tennessee while adding Arizona.
